_comment: Measured 2026-11-15/16 with bench.py (see README.md). cost = share of one session allowance for a 4.6k-token-in / ~170-token-out call with thinking off: $ <=0.01%, 14242 <=0.05%, 14242$ <=0.1%, 1424214242 more. bench = scores from bench.py (implement/honesty: 1 or 0; debug x/17 hidden tests; comprehend x/8; read out of 4; investigate out of 10, two runs). best_use = the conclusion drawn from those results.

code.instruction: Role: implementer. Produce working code as a unified diff, or a complete file if new.

review.instruction: Role: code reviewer. Find real defects; no style nitpicks. Mark anything you could not verify.

research.instruction: Role: researcher. Explain clearly and flag anything unverified.

bulk.instruction: Role: reader. Answer only from the material provided; quote the file that supports each claim; say 'not found' when it is not there.

beam.best_use: cheap, honest, 8/8 code reasoning; slow and variable on long tasks (4, no report)

clef:27b.notes: decision model (yes/no, choice, scoring via /v1/systemone); not a chat model
clef:27b.best_use: decision model (yes/no, choice, scoring through /v1/systemone), not a chat model; not benchmarked

deepseek-v4-pro:0813.best_use: consistent (7, 7; 8/8) but about 5x the price of deepseek-v4.1-flash and it invented an answer: second opinion only

deepseek-v4.1-flash.best_use: DEFAULT for one-shot review/research/code and second agent choice: 8/8 code reasoning, honest, finished every long run (10, 6, 6, 7)

deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017.best_use: pinned snapshot of deepseek-v4.1-flash; same behaviour on the short suite

gemma4:31b.best_use: fastest short coding agent (15 s for both tasks), 8/8 code reasoning; loops or stops early on long tasks; invents answers: only for short, test-verified tasks

glm-5.2.best_use: older GLM: fine on short tasks, variable on long (7, 4); glm-5.3-flash is cheaper and better

glm-5.3.best_use: very consistent (7, 7; 8/8; honest) but about 5x the price of glm-5.3-flash for the same result: second opinion only

glm-5.3-flash.best_use: DEFAULT AGENT for long or investigative work: most consistent strong long-review scores among cheap models (7, 9); honest; reads large input well

gpt-oss:120b.best_use: fast, cheap short agent tasks and quick answers; consistent but shallow on long reviews (4, 4); invents answers when it lacks the facts, so not for research

gpt-oss:20b.best_use: smallest model: weakest code reasoning (4/8), slow, unreliable on long tasks; only for trivial one-shot answers

inkling-2-small.notes: thinks even with thinking off; vision
inkling-2-small.best_use: fastest long-task finisher (45-85 s), honest, 8/8 code reasoning; medium depth (6, 4): quick first-pass investigations; cannot turn thinking off

kimi-k2.6.notes: timed out (502) when probed; do not use
kimi-k2.6.best_use: older Kimi: passes short tasks, slow on long ones (4, no report); was unavailable for part of the testing

kimi-k2.7-code.best_use: passes short coding tasks; long reviews stay at the easy findings (4, 4); invented an answer; nothing it does better than cheaper models

kimi-k3.best_use: consistent (7, 7; 8/8), the most expensive model (suite 11.9%), no better result here; invented an answer: not worth it for this work

kimi-k3.1-pro.best_use: consistent (7, 7; 8/8) at 10-30x the price of the cheap models with no better result here; invented an answer: not worth it for this work

mimo-v2.6-flash.best_use: DEFAULT for bulk reading and cheap all-round work: 4/4 reading at the lowest price; long reviews vary (7, 7, 4)

mimo-v2.6-pro.best_use: capable (best long review 9) but inconsistent (4.5); no clear gain over glm-5.3-flash at about twice the price

minimax-m3.best_use: slow on every task and no report in 10 minutes on long reviews (twice): avoid for agent work

minimax-m3.1-flash.best_use: passes short tasks cheaply but too slow for long agent work here (no report in 10 minutes, twice); one earlier 9/10 run shows it is capable when fast

mistral-large-4.notes: thinks even with thinking off; slow to first token; vision
mistral-large-4.best_use: too slow for agent work: timed out on the debugging task, the code-reasoning test and both long reviews

muse-spark-open.best_use: 8/8 code reasoning and honest, but long reviews stay at the easy findings (4, 4.5) while using the most tokens

nemotron-3-super.notes: timed out (502) when probed; do not use
nemotron-3-super.best_use: cheap, passes short tasks; inconsistent on long ones (4.5, 1) and weaker code reasoning (6/8)

nemotron-3-ultra.best_use: capable (4, 7) but slow: close to the 10-minute limit every run; invented answers twice
